title: 「農業分野におけるAI・データに関する契約ガイドライン」に関するQ＆A(PDF : 493KB)

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF)
covered_actors: Smart agricultural machinery manufacturers and vendors
Farmers and agricultural stakeholders (including producer groups, councils, extension advisors, and community farming organizations)

evidence.quote:
（問１）農林水産省の補助金等について、ガイドラインへの準拠が令和３年度から要件化されますが、 どのような利用規約が対象となりますか。

（答）農林水産省の補助事業等を用いて、スマート農機等を導入する場合のシステムサービス（ソフトウエア）の利用契約が対象になります。
evidence.quote_en: (Q1) Compliance with the Guidelines will become a requirement for MAFF subsidies, etc. starting from FY2021; what kind of terms of use are subject to this? (A) System service (software) usage contracts when introducing smart agricultural machinery, etc. using MAFF subsidized projects, etc. are subject to this.

evidence.quote: 要件化の対象となるスマート農機等については、提出すべき申請書類にガイドラインの準拠の要件化に対応していることが記載されたHP やカタログ等の写しを添付するよう求められることが想定されますので、それまでには契約ひな形の見直し、HP やカタログ等への記載等を済ませておいてください。
evidence.quote_en: For smart agricultural machinery, etc. subject to the requirement, it is expected that applicants will be asked to attach copies of websites or catalogs stating compliance with the Guidelines requirement to the application documents to be submitted, so please complete the review of contract templates and publication on websites or catalogs by then.

evidence.quote: 農林水産省の補助事業等を活用しないで自己資金で導入する場合はガイドラインの要件化の対象外となりますが、ガイドラインに沿った契約内容とすることが望ましいです。
evidence.quote_en: When introducing equipment with one's own funds without using MAFF subsidized projects, etc., it is outside the scope of the Guidelines requirement, but it is desirable to make the contract contents align with the Guidelines.

evidence.quote: システムサービスの提供者が弁護士等と相談の上、自己評価を行います。
evidence.quote_en: The system service provider conducts a self-evaluation in consultation with a lawyer, etc.

enforcement_authorities: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF)
compliance_deadlines: FY2021 (Reiwa 3): Guideline compliance became a requirement for eligible MAFF subsidy programs

Prior to annual MAFF subsidy application submissions (calls typically open from January onward for the following fiscal year): Vendors must complete contract template revisions and publish compliance notices on websites or catalogs
policy_extraction.penalties_summary: No statutory penalties are specified; in the event of a data leak after contracting under the guidelines, remedies such as damages are handled in accordance with the contractual terms agreed between the parties.
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This revised March 2024 Q&A clarifies compliance with MAFF's Contract Guidelines on AI and Data in the Agricultural Sector. Guideline compliance is required only as a condition for MAFF subsidy programs when introducing smart agricultural machinery, drones, robots, or IoT devices that transmit and store agricultural data on a service provider's server or cloud; self-funded deployments are outside the mandate, though compliance is recommended. System service providers verify compliance through self-assessment (consulting legal counsel and using MAFF's published checklist and model contracts) and disclose compliant products on websites or catalogs. Free contract consultation is available via INPIT's Intellectual Property Comprehensive Support Desks across all 47 prefectures.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document's dominant framing is innovation_enablement because it explicitly justifies the AI and Data Contract Guidelines as necessary to build a trustworthy contracting environment that encourages farmers to share data, harmonizes data utilization with know-how protection, avoids transactional disputes, and accelerates the adoption and R&D of smart agriculture. It edges out economic_competitiveness, which appears only as a secondary rationale in references to protecting commercial trade secrets/know-how from external or overseas outflow and supporting regional agricultural development and productivity.

evidence_spans.quote: スマート農業の普及に不可欠なデータの利活用を促進するためには、農業者が安心してデータを提供できるよう、ノウハウの流出を防止する契約とする必要があるため、ガイドラインに基づいた契約を推奨しています。
evidence_spans.quote_en: In order to promote the utilization of data essential for the spread of smart agriculture, it is necessary to have contracts that prevent the leakage of know-how so that farmers can provide data with peace of mind; therefore, contracts based on the guidelines are recommended.

evidence_spans.quote: ビッグデータ等を活用したスマート農業を進めるため、ガイドラインは、データ利活用の促進とノウハウの保護の調和を図るためのルールを示しており、ガイドラインに沿った契約であれば、農業者は安心してスマート農業事業者等に対し、データを提供できるようになります。
evidence_spans.quote_en: To advance smart agriculture utilizing big data and similar technologies, the guidelines set out rules to harmonize the promotion of data utilization with the protection of know-how, and with contracts aligned with the guidelines, farmers can provide data to smart agriculture service providers with peace of mind.

evidence_spans.quote: 例えば、特定の地域（産地）外に流出させたくないノウハウが含まれるデータ等について、利用目的を「○○地域の農業の発展と生産性向上」と設定する場合は、地域外の農業関係者等に共有されることは想定されません
evidence_spans.quote_en: For example, with respect to data containing know-how that one does not want to leak outside a specific region (producing area), if the purpose of use is set as 'development and productivity improvement of agriculture in Region XX,' it is not anticipated to be shared with agricultural stakeholders outside the region.

evidence_spans.quote: データが法的に保護されることは限定的であり、データの保護を契約等により適切に行わなければ、たとえば、データ流出や不正利用に伴って、営業秘密やノウハウが外部に流出するおそれがあります。
evidence_spans.quote_en: Legal protection of data is limited, and if data is not appropriately protected through contracts or other means, there is a risk that trade secrets and know-how may leak externally due to data breaches or unauthorized use.
